records.text: At overseas military bases, female recruiters posing as casting directors find young women for senior personnel, and those women lack legal protection once brought onto a base.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep ZZGWo6oDscc)

appearances.snippet: And so what they are telling me adds up. It's tracking. What they say is, okay, think of a military base. Anywhere in the world, you have a bunch of men who do not have regular access to women. ... they tell me that they will typically send someone out who will be a woman, so think of like a Ghislaine Maxwell, to go out and to find them their interests, their tastes, young women that can be manipulated. That person will often describe themselves as a casting director to go out there and to tell the women to come onto the base. Once they're on the base, anything can happen to them. Like I said, they are afforded no protections from their government and our government is not going to prosecute the men that do anything on that base.

verification.notes: The transcript attributes this account to unnamed people contacted by Owens. Searches found documented trafficking and prostitution around some overseas U.S. bases, but no reliable source substantiated the specific recurring method of female recruiters posing as casting directors for senior personnel or the categorical claim that women brought onto bases have no legal protection. Anonymous-source details cannot be corroborated from available evidence.

records.text: Ghislaine Maxwell says 29 Epstein associates cut secret Justice Department deals, and six co-conspirator names are available if records are unredacted.
records.speaker: Jared Moskowitz

appearances.snippet: Ghislaine Maxwell says 29 Epstein associates cut secret DOJ deals. ... Six names readily available if you unredact them. Co-conspirators named, ... but we got them when you unredact them.

verification.notes: Maxwell's filed claim, as summarized in an official congressional letter, identifies four named co-conspirators plus 25 men who allegedly received secret settlements and were not indicted. That supports the 29-person arithmetic but overstates the record by describing all 29 as associates who received secret DOJ deals and by merging distinct groups.

sources.title: Rep. Khanna Letter Regarding Maxwell Deposition
sources.relevance: Official congressional letter distinguishes four named co-conspirators from 25 men Maxwell says received secret settlements.

records.text: Owens clarified that Charlie Kirk and Erika Kirk had their first date in August 2018, when the unsealing of the Ghislaine Maxwell–Virginia Giuffre defamation lawsuit was helping bring renewed attention to the Epstein scandal.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It was rather when Charlie (Charlie Kirk) and Erika (Erika Kirk) went on their first date. In August of 2018, that was the exact same time frame when the Epstein (Jeffrey Epstein) scandal initially broke out, right? It was the unsealing of a lawsuit between Ghislaine Maxwell and Virginia (Virginia Giuffre), the young woman who was at the source of the Epstein (Jeffrey Epstein) scandal, a defamation lawsuit, and it led to this massive exposé in the Miami Herald, a full piece on Jeffrey Epstein and the sweet deal that he got.

verification.notes: Public accounts place the Kirk relationship meeting in 2018, with sources varying between August and September. Court records show the Miami Herald moved to unseal records in 2018 and filed an August 27 motion, but the records themselves were not unsealed then; major releases followed in 2019. The November 2018 Miami Herald investigation is correctly dated.

sources.title: Giuffre v. Maxwell, Document 953
sources.relevance: Records the Miami Herald motion to unseal filed August 27, 2018 rather than an actual August 2018 unsealing.

sources.relevance: Reports the 2018 restaurant meeting from the account Erika Kirk posted in 2023.

records.text: Virginia Giuffre said Epstein had bragged that he had slept with more than 1,000 of Brunel's girls from Brunel's modeling agency.
records.speaker: Virginia Giuffre

appearances.snippet: Now, when that court case—which they tried to hush up—that Virginia Giuffre had against Ghislaine Maxwell ... When that got unsealed, it was revealed that she said that Epstein had bragged that he had slept with over 1,000 of Brunel's girls, referring to the modeling agency that he ran.

verification.notes: Virginia Giuffre stated in a sworn affidavit and repeated in a 2019 NBC Dateline interview that Epstein told her he had slept with more than 1,000 women or girls brought by Brunel. This verifies that Giuffre made the attributed statement, not that the underlying numerical boast was independently proven.
